intro.h2: Kitchen remodeling in St. Charles, MO, that keeps what you love
paragraphs: The Stone Company STL handles kitchen remodeling in St. Charles, MO, and the greater St. Louis area, with quartz and granite countertops at the center of it. A big change does not always mean replacing everything. In one recent kitchen we refinished and painted the original cabinets antique white, then added new hardware, quartz counters, an undermount sink, a tile backsplash, light fixtures and flooring.

Owner Nick Buehler stays close to every job. One homeowner calls him personable and professional and is very pleased with her kitchen remodel. Another says our backsplash turned out perfect. A local cabinet painting company that works alongside us says the quality of our stone work adds a high-end finish that makes a big difference.

services.h2: Countertops, backsplashes and full kitchen refreshes

items.name: Quartz and granite countertops
items.blurb: Stone is in our name. We install quartz and granite countertops for kitchens, islands and bars, including undermount sinks. In the basement bar shown here, a white and gray granite runs the full L-shaped counter and wraps a raised bar top over a black beadboard island.

image.alt: Basement bar with white and gray granite countertops, a raised granite bar top on a black beadboard island and black cabinets

items.name: Tile backsplashes
items.blurb: A backsplash ties the counters, cabinets and walls together. Two of our Google reviews mention backsplash installation, and one customer says everything turned out perfect. We help you choose a tile and layout that suits your countertop and finish it neatly around outlets and windows.

items.name: Full kitchen refreshes
items.blurb: A refresh keeps your layout and changes everything you see. In the kitchen shown here we painted the original cabinets antique white and added black hardware, quartz counters, an undermount sink, a tile backsplash, glass lantern lighting, new flooring and fresh paint for a bright, finished room.

image.alt: Refreshed kitchen with antique white painted cabinets, quartz island with seating, subway tile backsplash and three black lantern pendants

items.name: Cabinet refinishing and painting
items.blurb: Good cabinet boxes rarely need replacing. Refinishing and painting them in a fresh color, then adding new hardware, gives a kitchen a new look for far less disruption. We also partner with a local cabinet painting company when a project calls for it.

about.text: The Stone Company STL is a kitchen remodeler serving homeowners in St. Charles and the greater St. Louis area. Owner Nick Buehler focuses the business on quartz and granite countertop installations, tile backsplashes and full kitchen refreshes, and he often works alongside a local cabinet painting company to deliver complete kitchen transformations. In his words, he is grateful to all his customers, present and past, for trusting him to bring their vision to life. We are open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 4:30 PM and Saturday from 10 AM to 1 PM.

process.h2: How a kitchen refresh comes together

steps.title: Call Nick
steps.text: Call (314) 919-5180 on weekdays from 9 AM to 4:30 PM or Saturday morning and tell us about your kitchen.

steps.title: Plan the upgrades
steps.text: We look at what you love about the kitchen and what you want changed, then pick the upgrades that will make the biggest difference.

steps.title: Choose stone and tile
steps.text: You choose countertop, backsplash tile, hardware and lighting, and we coordinate any cabinet painting, plumbing or electrical work that goes with them.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Countertops, sink, backsplash and fixtures go in, along with flooring and paint when they are part of the plan.

steps.title: Enjoy the new kitchen
steps.text: We walk the finished kitchen with you and stay available for the next project, from a basement bar to a bathroom.

service_area.h2: Kitchen remodeling in St. Charles, MO and the St. Louis area
service_area.text: The Stone Company STL works with homeowners in St. Charles and the greater St. Louis area. Whether you want new quartz or granite counters, a tile backsplash or a full kitchen refresh, call (314) 919-5180 and tell us where your home is. We will confirm that we cover your area and set up a time to come see the kitchen in person.

items.q: Do I have to replace my cabinets?
items.a: Often you do not. In one recent kitchen we refinished and painted the original cabinets antique white, kept the layout the homeowners liked and focused on high-impact upgrades: new hardware, quartz counters, an undermount sink, a tile backsplash, lighting, flooring and paint. The result was a dramatic change without starting over.

items.q: Do you install quartz or granite?
items.a: Both. Quartz and granite countertop installation is at the core of what we do, for kitchens, islands and bars. Our photos include quartz counters and an island in a refreshed kitchen and a white and gray granite bar with a raised ledge. We can include an undermount sink with the install.

items.q: Can you install a tile backsplash with new counters?
items.a: Yes. Tile backsplash installation is one of our main services and one of the topics customers mention most in their Google reviews. Pairing it with new countertops lets us plan the tile, outlets and edges around the stone, so the two finish together cleanly.

You work with owner Nick Buehler. Customers describe him as personable and professional, and he answers reviews himself. For cabinet refinishing and interior painting we often team up with a local cabinet painting company, which lets us deliver a complete kitchen transformation from counters to cabinets.

We are open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 4:30 PM and Saturday from 10 AM to 1 PM, and closed on Sunday. Call (314) 919-5180 during those hours to talk about countertops, a backsplash or a full kitchen refresh in St. Charles or the St. Louis area.
